<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Here Is My Card|id=A0072}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
A few Lojban words can make a big difference when you are networking. So does a nice business card, which is also our keyword: '''tarjeta de presentación''' – business card.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0027|A0027: The Neighbor]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0082|A0082: My name is...]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0112|A0112: What is your telephone number?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| It's been my pleasure.
| '''Igualmente.'''
| Likewise.
| '''¿Me puedes dar tu e-mail?'''
| Can you give me your e-mail?
| '''Mejor te doy mi tarjeta de presentación.'''
| I'll better give you my business card.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| It's been my pleasure.
| '''Igualmente.'''
| Likewise.
| '''¿Me puedes dar tu e-mail?'''
| Can you give me your e-mail?
| '''Mejor te doy mi tarjeta de presentación.'''
| I'll better give you my business card.
}}</includeonly>

| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| Likewise.
| '''Igualmente.'''
| Can you give me your e-mail?
| '''¿Me puedes dar tu e-mail?'''

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| It's been my pleasure.
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| Likewise. I'll give you my e-mail. 
| '''Igualmente. Te doy mi e-mail.'''
| I'll better give you my business card.
| '''Mejor te doy mi tarjeta de presentación.'''
| Thank you very much.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| It's been my pleasure.
| '''Mucho gusto.'''
| Likewise. I'll give you my e-mail. 
| '''Igualmente. Te doy mi e-mail.'''
| I'll better give you my business card.
| '''Mejor te doy mi tarjeta de presentación.'''
| Thank you very much.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
